subject: Developer-only unconstrained host-action text metrics
notes: These are raw developer-authored host actions with automatic intrinsic widths, not Ant Design Button measurements.
Windows GPUI font advance hinting at 150% scale produced a 1.09896px intrinsic-width discrepancy; the Result wrapper does not determine child text metrics.

The paired Result layout gate therefore uses equivalent explicit 72px/68px action widths in both upstream and native fixtures. It does not claim unconstrained host actions or Ant Design Button intrinsic widths meet the 1px bound.
The full original diagnostic report remains in build/ant-design-gpui/result-comparison-before-paint-fix.json.
